description: Issue #32: Implement the three accessibility / action-feedback improvements, all frontend-only. (1) Reset confirm dialog (role=alertdialog) focus control: move focus to the Confirm button on open, Escape triggers Cancel, and a simple two-button focus trap keeps Tab within the dialog; restore focus to the reset trigger on close is a nice-to-have. (2) Busy affordance on care + battle actions: add a lightweight, accessible busy indicator (aria-busy + visually-hidden status text and/or a small spinner respecting prefers-reduced-motion) while game.busy is true, WITHOUT duplicating or clashing with the #10 care-fx sprite overlay. (3) Evolution ✓/・ markers: add an accessible met/unmet label (JA 達成/未達成, EN met/not met) via a pure resolver in ui-helpers.ts so the state is not color-only; keep the existing glyph and visual. Add JA+EN i18n keys for all new strings and pure-helper unit tests in game-ui.test.ts.
steps: i18n (packages/frontend/src/i18n.ts): add new keys to BOTH JA_MESSAGES and EN_MESSAGES (byte-identical for existing keys; new keys in both or tsc fails). Suggested keys: 'status.busy' (JA '処理中…', EN 'Working…'); 'evolution.met' (JA '達成', EN 'met'); 'evolution.unmet' (JA '未達成', EN 'not met'). Place them in sensibly commented groups.

Pure helpers (packages/frontend/src/ui-helpers.ts): add a DOM-free resolver `evolutionReqAriaLabel(met: boolean, lang: Lang): string` that returns t(lang,'evolution.met') when met else t(lang,'evolution.unmet'); and if useful a `busyStatusLabel(lang: Lang): string` returning t(lang,'status.busy'). Follow the existing pattern (import { t } and type Lang from ./i18n.ts). Document with JSDoc like the neighbors.

Unit tests (packages/frontend/src/game-ui.test.ts): add node:test cases importing the new helpers. Cover evolutionReqAriaLabel(true/false) in ja and en returning the exact strings, and busyStatusLabel ja/en. Keep DOM/React out of the test file.

StatsPanel (packages/frontend/src/components/StatsPanel.tsx): on each `.evolution-req`

(training row and age row), add an accessible met/unmet label without changing the visual. Keep the existing aria-hidden ✓/・ glyph. Approach: add a visually-hidden (e.g. className 'visually-hidden') whose text is evolutionReqAriaLabel(prog.trainingMet, lang) / evolutionReqAriaLabel(prog.ageMet, lang) placed inside the

so screen readers announce met/not-met. Import useI18n lang already available; import the helper from ../ui-helpers.ts.

Reset dialog focus control (packages/frontend/src/App.tsx): the alertdialog is the `confirmingReset` block (role=alertdialog). (a) Add a ref to the Confirm button (useRef<HTMLButtonElement>) and a useEffect keyed on confirmingReset that focuses it when the dialog opens. (b) Add onKeyDown on the dialog container: Escape -> setConfirmingReset(false) (Cancel). (c) Simple focus trap: on Tab/Shift+Tab within the dialog, keep focus cycling between the Confirm and Cancel buttons (two-button trap; e.g. track first/last focusable and wrap). (d) Nice-to-have: capture the reset trigger element (or a ref to the reset button) before opening and restore focus to it on close. Do not change the existing reset behavior (#20): Confirm still calls handleReset (game.reset) and hides; Cancel still hides.

Busy affordance - CarePanel (packages/frontend/src/components/CarePanel.tsx): while busy, surface a subtle accessible indicator. Add aria-busy={busy} to the care-panel section (or buttons) and render a visually-hidden live status (e.g. {busy ? t('status.busy') : ''}) and/or a small spinner element shown only when busy. Keep buttons disabled={busy} as-is. Do NOT add a sprite overlay here (the #10 care-fx already animates on the sprite from App.tsx) - this indicator lives in the panel, not over the sprite, to avoid double-signalling.

Busy affordance - BattlePanel (packages/frontend/src/components/BattlePanel.tsx): mirror the CarePanel approach for the battle button area (aria-busy / role=status visually-hidden '処理中…' and/or small spinner), shown while the `busy` prop is true. Ensure it does not interfere with the existing #9 battle playback animation or the result/log rendering; keep disabled={busy} on the battle button.

Styles (packages/frontend/src/styles.css): add a `.visually-hidden` utility class (clip/absolute off-screen) if one does not already exist, reusing it for the sr-only labels. Add a small `.spinner` (or `.busy-spinner`) style if you render a spinner, with a keyframe rotation; MUST be disabled/stilled under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) following the existing convention in the file. Keep additions minimal and consistent with existing variables.
Verify: run the build and both test suites; confirm JA strings for existing keys are unchanged (git diff i18n.ts shows only additions).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` exits 0 (confirms JA/EN i18n key parity and TS types).
`npm test` still reports 47 passing shared tests.
`npm test -w @ddm/frontend` reports >=62 passing (59 baseline + new helper tests).
Opening the reset confirm dialog moves focus to the Confirm button; pressing Escape closes it as Cancel (no reset); Tab/Shift+Tab stays within the two dialog buttons.
While a care or battle action is in flight (busy), an accessible busy indicator (aria-busy and/or role=status '処理中…'/'Working…') is present and does not duplicate the sprite care-fx overlay.
Each evolution condition row exposes an accessible met/unmet label (達成/未達成, met/not met) in addition to the ✓/・ glyph and color; existing visual is unchanged.
git diff of i18n.ts shows existing JA/EN values unchanged (only new keys added).
Any new spinner animation is stilled under prefers-reduced-motion.
verification: git diff --stat main -- packages/frontend/src/i18n.ts (confirm only additions)
Optional: build the frontend (npm run build -w @ddm/frontend) and run a Playwright check serving dist/ to confirm focus-on-open and Escape-cancel; if not feasible, document manual verification steps.
findings:
Implemented all three Issue #32 improvements, frontend-only. Files changed: - packages/frontend/src/i18n.ts: added 3 keys to BOTH JA and EN (existing values untouched; `git diff main` shows only additions): 'status.busy' (JA '処理中…' / EN 'Working…'), 'evolution.met' (JA '達成' / EN 'met'), 'evolution.unmet' (JA '未達成' / EN 'not met'). - packages/frontend/src/ui-helpers.ts: added two pure, DOM-free helpers: evolutionReqAriaLabel(met, lang) -> t(lang,'evolution.met'|'evolution.unmet'); busyStatusLabel(lang) -> t(lang,'status.busy'). - packages/frontend/src/game-ui.test.ts: added 3 node:test cases (evolutionReqAriaLabel ja/en met+unmet, i18n-key equivalence, busyStatusLabel ja/en). Frontend count 59 -> 62. - packages/frontend/src/components/StatsPanel.tsx: each .evolution-req

(training + age) now has a with evolutionReqAriaLabel(prog.trainingMet/ageMet, lang) before the text, so met/unmet is announced to SRs; the aria-hidden ✓/・ glyph and color are unchanged. - packages/frontend/src/components/CarePanel.tsx: section gets aria-busy={busy}; a visually-hidden announces busyStatusLabel(lang) while busy; a small .busy-spinner shows in the heading. Buttons keep disabled={busy}. No sprite overlay (avoids clashing with App.tsx care-fx). - packages/frontend/src/components/BattlePanel.tsx: mirrors CarePanel (aria-busy, role=status live region, .busy-spinner) without touching the #9 playback animation / result / log. Battle button keeps disabled={busy}. - packages/frontend/src/App.tsx: reset confirm alertdialog now moves focus to the Confirm button on open (falls back to Cancel if Confirm disabled), Escape triggers Cancel, a two-button Tab/Shift+Tab trap keeps focus between Confirm and Cancel, and focus is restored to the reset trigger on close. Added aria-modal='true'. Reset behavior (#20) unchanged: Confirm still calls handleReset (game.reset) then closes; Cancel closes. Added resetTriggerRef/confirmBtnRef/cancelBtnRef, a useEffect keyed on confirmingReset, closeResetConfirm, and handleResetDialogKeyDown. Imported React KeyboardEvent type as ReactKeyboardEvent. - packages/frontend/src/styles.css: added .visually-hidden utility (off-screen clip) and .busy-spinner (border + busy-spin rotation keyframe), with the spinner animation stilled under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) per the existing convention. Verification (PATH exported for node v22.23.3): - npm run build (root): exit 0 (confirms JA/EN key parity + TS types; vite build succeeded). - npm test (shared): 47 pass, 0 fail. - npm test -w @ddm/frontend: 62 pass, 0 fail (>=62 target met). - git diff main -- i18n.ts: additions only; existing JA/EN values byte-identical. A11y DOM behavior verification: the pure logic (met/unmet + busy label) is unit-tested in game-ui.test.ts. The focus-move/Escape/trap are standard DOM behaviors and were NOT exercised via Playwright: the reset trigger is gated on a loaded monster (resetDisabled) which requires backend/localStorage state, so a dist-only Playwright harness would need request interception/state stubbing that was out of scope here. Manual verification steps: (1) load the app with a monster present; (2) click Reset -> focus lands on the 'リセットする'/'Reset' Confirm button; (3) press Tab/Shift+Tab repeatedly -> focus stays cycling between Confirm and Cancel only; (4) press Escape -> dialog closes without resetting and focus returns to the Reset trigger; (5) click Confirm -> monster resets and dialog closes. Busy affordance: trigger a care/battle action and observe aria-busy toggling, the role=status announcement, and the spinner (stilled under reduced motion). Commits on feat/a11y-action-feedback: - feat(frontend): evolution met/unmet a11y labels and busy action feedback (#32) - feat(frontend): reset confirm dialog focus control, Escape, and two-button trap (#32) No new runtime dependencies. No backend/shared/infra changes. Not pushed; no PR.
